activities.label: Learn
activities.title: ATP energy transfer
activities.body: Read the explanation, then answer the next question from memory.

essentialIdeas: ATP transfers energy by losing a phosphate group to become ADP.

activities.concept: ATP transfers energy by losing a phosphate group to become ADP.
activities.label: Explain
activities.title: ATP energy transfer
activities.body: How does ATP transfer energy in cells?
activities.correctAnswer: ATP transfers energy when it loses one phosphate group and becomes ADP.
activities.feedback: This links energy release to phosphate removal, not to ATP breaking apart completely.

activities.concept: ATP transfers energy by losing a phosphate group to become ADP.
activities.label: Repair
activities.title: Repair the first explanation
activities.body: Compare the first explanation with this verified reference: ATP transfers energy when it loses one phosphate group and becomes ADP. Correct the exposed relationship in your own words without copying the reference.
activities.correctAnswer: ATP transfers energy when it loses one phosphate group and becomes ADP.
activities.feedback: This links energy release to phosphate removal, not to ATP breaking apart completely.

activities.concept: ATP transfers energy by losing a phosphate group to become ADP.
activities.label: Explain again
activities.title: Explain the corrected relationship again
activities.body: How does ATP transfer energy in cells? Explain it again after the repair without copying the model or reference answer.
activities.correctAnswer: ATP transfers energy when it loses one phosphate group and becomes ADP.
activities.feedback: This links energy release to phosphate removal, not to ATP breaking apart completely.

activities.concept: Recognition transfer: ATP transfers energy by losing a phosphate group to become ADP.
activities.label: Recall check
activities.title: ATP and energy transfer
activities.body: Which statement best describes ATP energy transfer?
choices: ATP releases energy when it loses a phosphate group and becomes ADP.
ATP stores energy by gaining a phosphate group from ADP.
ATP becomes glucose after releasing energy.
ATP transfers energy only by changing into oxygen.
activities.correctAnswer: ATP releases energy when it loses a phosphate group and becomes ADP.
activities.feedback: The correct idea is phosphate loss from ATP, which leaves ADP.
